title: Saudi-Arabian Celery Grill
description: A sweet and savory dish featuring the flavors of Saudi Arabia, perfect for a lazy Sunday evening. This recipe uses a binchotan grill for a smoky flavor and paleo-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use celery salt for added flavor

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the ghee, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Brush the mixture onto the celery stalks, reserving a small amount for serving.
Place the celery stalks on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until tender and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining ghee mixture in a small saucepan over low heat.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
To serve, place the grilled celery stalks on a plate and drizzle with the parsley-infused ghee.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
